_about: Measured design tokens. Component-level geometry, rims, sources and Flowics usage live in element-registry.json (the main entry point); this file holds the shared values. px = 1x on 1920x1080.

shape.edgePlacement: slanted edges sit 0.35-0.8px outside the Flowics box (slantOutsetPx), straight edges ~0.3px inside (straightInsetPx) - per component in element-registry.json
shape.radiusNote: medians of the on-air corner fits (video x mask); masks alone fit 6px but are hard-edged and larger than the visible video corner

mainRow.note: logo box + ticker/text line; NAMNSKYLT variant also sits here

topRow.note: PLATS ALT INFO; split variant at y 21.6

bevel.model: directional rim, lit from the upper left (~117 deg): per-edge layer colours + per-angle colours around each rounded corner + variation along each edge (element-registry.json components[].bevel: top/right/bottom/left, corners, along)
bevel.renderer: src/lower-third.js rimRings(): each layer is a continuous even-thickness ring (outer bleed minus concentric inset), deepest first; straight zones = edge colour + measured variation, corners = gradients on the measured per-angle colours, mapped on each ring's radius
bevel.verification: edge pixels median RGB distance 1.4 vs the Flowics source; corner rim light mean |diff| 9-21 on a 150-430 range

fills._about: Measured on the 2x Flowics sources. All plate gradients are horizontal (no tilt, no vertical shading) and scale with the plate width (objectBoundingBox x 0..1); sRGB interpolation. Verified: column-profile difference 0.5-0.7 levels (compression noise floor).
fills.redNote: straight 2-stop ramp, identical on all 7 red logo boxes (210-392px wide)

gold.note: diagonal, dark bottom-left -> light top-right (plane fit; residual rms = the glitter) + two-scale glitter texture

glint._about: Measured at 30 fps on the Flowics videos; per-element values in element-registry.json components[].glint
glint.model: white band with gaussian profile (sigma ~41-47px, FWHM ~97-110px), tilted dx/dy ~0.33 (leans ''), linear travel, measured opacity envelope (rises, peaks, falls; logo box plateaus)
glint.verification: vs the Flowics videos: band centre within ~0-9px, peak opacity within 0.017, FWHM matches at 3 times per element

efnLogo.source: assets/logos/EFN_logo.svg (client asset; glyph bbox 124,88 752x324 in a 1000x500 viewBox)
efnLogo.dropEdge: hard black edge below, offset (0.3, 1), blur 0.3
efnLogo.innerShading: slight darkening at the lower part of the E/F crossbars (#e1e1e1 -> #a4a4a4), not reproduced yet

logoBoxWordmark.placement: scale ~0.21 px per SVG unit, caps at y 16.75..55.7; per-variant fitted transform in element-registry.json
logoBoxWordmark.note: a dark top/left edge (first guess) made edges darker than the source and was removed after scoring against the frames

title.box: hugs text: padding left 0.5em, right 0.8em, top 0.18em, bottom 0.22em

location.box: same em padding as title, navy still image

columnRamp.shape: columns 1-3: right-slanted, sharp corners; last column: straight right edge, right corners radius 2.6 (see element-registry ticker-column-ramp.lastColumn)
columnRamp.clip: all column content is clipped to the ticker plate silhouette

animation.engine: GSAP keyframe pairs; full table in reference/flowics/animation-presets.json
animation.slideLeftSolidIn: x -100% -> 0 while clip-path inset(0 0 0 100%) -> inset(0) (content slides out from under its own left edge)
animation.logoLine: L/R plates slide in from their sides 600ms; EFN logo expandIn 300ms @600 (power1); back gradient fadeIn 900ms
animation.textUpdate: TEXT-LINE-* / ticker text on air: old text slideLeftSolidOut 500ms, new text slideRightSolidIn 500ms (sine.in)
animation.credits: Slutskylt rows slideLeftSolidIn 600ms (slow) staggered @600/1000/1400 (Nobel: 590/885/1250/1590); no out animation
animation.startSlates: overlay fadeIn ~405ms; ED_startskylt fadeOut 200ms, Börslunch start has no out

states.model: 7 regions, each shows at most one overlay (single activeOverlayId); taking another overlay in the same region replaces it
states.notableExclusivity: NAMNSKYLT lives in the LOGOBOX region -> name in the main row replaces the logo box
states.triggers: no conditionals, no onTakeIn/onTakeOut events: sequencing is done by the operator via the remote controller (vizControlV2)
remoteControls: Remote.List cycle interval on 8 ticker lists
dataStates: value box colour up/down/neutral from feed

refinements._about: EFN additions on top of the measured Flowics look (designed, not measured): physical text shading, and a soft shaped vignette on the beige plates that works with their narrow rims. On by default; createRenderer({ refinements: false }) draws the exact Flowics replica. px on the 1920x1080 canvas. Bold dark text (title, ticker names) is drawn lighter: `darkText.weight` thickened by a stroke of `darkText.strokeEm` in the text colour, a synthetic semibold between AkkuratStd 400 and 700, so the shading doesn't make it look heavy. Logos (EFN logo, programme wordmarks) get the light-text shading on top of their measured treatment. Text: ambient and contact are drop shadows (offset dx/dy, gaussian blur = stdDeviation); rim is the light caught by the glyphs' top-left inner edge and shade the darkening of their bottom-right inner edge (light text only: on dark text it was invisible) (band width = the offset, softened by blur). Vignette: towards its edges the plate's own colour is burnt in (gamma exponent `burn` > 1 darkens and adds contrast, `saturate` > 1 enriches the colour) rather than greyed. Strength at distance d from the nearest edge = `opacity` x [(1 - `edgeShare`) x (1 - d / `width`)^`curve` + `edgeShare` x exp(-d / `edgeWidth`)]: a long, gentle ramp over `width` px plus a narrow band that rises to full strength only in the last few px; corners are never stronger than the edges beside them (`cornerSoftness` rounds the mitre where the two edges' falloffs meet). `dx`/`dy` shift it towards the light (upper left).

rendering.recommended: render at UHD (3840x2160, = the 2x source resolution) and downscale 2x2 to 1080p
rendering.why: rims are 0.5px layers (one source pixel at 2x); native 1080p rendering also adds coloured sub-pixel fringes on text
rendering.previewSvg: dist/preview/on-air-capture.svg has no fixed size: it fills whatever viewport renders it
